receipt.scope: read-only input hashes; no inference or simulation

statistics_scope.ranking_unit: One replicate is a complete set of 24 fixed episodes for all five methods plus paired FV-hold.
statistics_scope.probabilities: Empirical conditional Monte Carlo proportions across independent replicate draw plans; Wilson 95% intervals quantify simulation sampling precision only.
statistics_scope.distributions: Replicate means and changes relative to the fixed zero-delay baseline; median, 2.5/97.5 percentiles, min/max. Percentile spread is not a confidence interval.
statistics_scope.ties: Costs within 1e-10 are tied; strict reversals exclude ties.
statistics_scope.scope: Conditional on fixed models, fixed 24 episodes, observed timing pools and IID sampler. No inference over new hardware, training seeds, physical plants, or episode population.
statistics_scope.precision: 16 is a pilot budget. Choose at least 64 before launch for tighter Monte Carlo probability precision; neither budget resolves empirical-pool or hardware uncertainty.
